Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console

Class ToolkitPackRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.ToolkitPackRegistry
public final class ToolkitPackRegistry extends Object
Registry of named toolkit packs for the <@page toolkit=...> directive and for the packs cards require.

Built-in packs:

  • "jquery", "datatables" and "datatables-buttons" (ToolkitPack.Kind.VENDOR) — WebJars, resolved through WEBJAR_RESOLVER to the host's WebJarsMixin mount. "datatables" depends on "jquery"; "datatables-buttons" on "datatables".
  • "datatables-glue" (ToolkitPack.Kind.VENDOR) — the first-party glue (ViewsMixin.DATATABLES_JS_PATH, served by DataTablesMixin); depends on "datatables". Every <@card type="datatables"> requires it.
  • "views" (ToolkitPack.Kind.RUNTIME) — the views runtime. JS order is a contract: bus (first), renders, icons, search, pagestate, urlstate, ribbon, views, config, regions, run-view, helpers. juneau-urlstate.js must precede juneau-views.js / juneau-config.js.
  • "calendar" (ToolkitPack.Kind.RUNTIME) — the juneau-calendar.* runtime from juneau-rest-server-widgets, resolved through WIDGETS_RESOLVER.
  • "xterm" (ToolkitPack.Kind.VENDOR) — the xterm.js WebJar (library and stylesheet), resolved through WEBJAR_RESOLVER.
  • "terminal" (ToolkitPack.Kind.RUNTIME) — the juneau-terminal.* runtime from juneau-rest-server-terminal, resolved through TerminalMixin.terminalAssetUrl(RestRequest, String); depends on "views" and "xterm". Every <@card type="terminal"> requires it, so a page with a terminal card needs no toolkit=.
  • "charts" (ToolkitPack.Kind.RUNTIME) — juneau-charts.js from juneau-rest-server-console-ui, resolved through ConsoleChromeMixin.consoleAssetUrl(RestRequest, String); depends on "echarts" and "data". Every <@card type="chart"> requires it.
  • "joblog" (ToolkitPack.Kind.RUNTIME) — juneau-joblog.js from juneau-rest-server-console-ui; no dependencies. Every <@card type="job-log"> requires it.
  • "echarts" (ToolkitPack.Kind.VENDOR) — the ECharts WebJar (ECHARTS_JS_ASSET), optional on the classpath: a missing jar is E-70 at startup when the app opts in (ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder.requirePacks), else at the first chart page.
  • "echarts-gl" (ToolkitPack.Kind.VENDOR) — the echarts-gl WebJar; depends on "echarts"; a page opts in with toolkit("echarts-gl").
  • "data" (ToolkitPack.Kind.RUNTIME) — juneau-data.js (JuneauViews.data); depends on "views".

resolve(List, RestRequest, List, String) expands the requested packs depth-first over ToolkitPack.dependsOn() (each pack after its dependencies, siblings in request order, each pack once), skips provided packs (their dependencies still load), skips an asset whose file name the page already loads through init= or css= (with a WARN), and splits the result by kind. validate() checks the static graph: unknown dependsOn names, cycles, and a VENDOR pack depending on a RUNTIME pack.

Since:
10.0.0

    • checkWebJars

      public ToolkitPackRegistry checkWebJars(Collection<String> roots)
      Probes, at startup, every WebJar the given packs reach: each non-provided VENDOR pack resolved through WEBJAR_RESOLVER.

      roots - Root pack names; empty probes nothing.

    • resolve

      public ToolkitPackRegistry.Resolved resolve(List<String> names, RestRequest req, List<String> pageUrls, String template)
      Resolves the root packs and their dependencies to absolute URLs, split by kind.
      Parameters:
      names - The root pack names, in order. Empty or null = nothing (no request needed).
      req - The in-flight request.
      pageUrls - The page's own init= and css= URLs; a pack asset with the same file name is skipped with a WARN.
      template - The page template name, for the WARN.
      Returns:
      The resolved URLs.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - On an unknown pack or a cycle.
      IllegalStateException - If the request is missing or a resolver fails (e.g. a WebJar isn't on the classpath).
